clues: Of the marcher with the caramels and the one with the licorice, one was a mermaid and the other a robot.
Either Dot or Hugo handed out 100 pieces.
The taffy came from either Otis or Mabel.
Hugo handed out more pieces than the scarecrow did.
The taffy and the licorice came from two different marchers: one gave away 50 pieces, the other 125 pieces.
The mermaid handed out fewer pieces than Otis.
Whoever had the caramels handed out exactly 25 more pieces than the pirate.
hints: Look at the 125-piece column in the costume box. Which costume could possibly have handed out the most?
Comparisons rule out the ends. Clue 5 keeps the scarecrow off 125 pieces. What do clues 7 and 8 say about the mermaid and the pirate?
So the robot handed out 125, with caramels or licorice (clue 1). By clue 6, the taffy was 50 and the licorice 125.
Clue 7 keeps Otis off 50, so by clue 3 Mabel had the 50-piece taffy. Then clues 7 and 2 leave Otis only 125: the robot.

solution.key_idea: Clues 5, 7 and 8 keep the scarecrow, mermaid and pirate off 125 pieces, so the robot handed out the most.
steps: Clue 5 keeps the scarecrow off 125 pieces, clue 7 the mermaid, and clue 8 the pirate. So the robot handed out 125.
By clue 1, the robot had caramels or licorice, not taffy. So by clue 6, the taffy was 50 and the licorice 125, the robot's.
By clue 1, the mermaid had the caramels. Clue 7 keeps Otis off 50, so by clue 3 Mabel had the taffy, at 50.
The mermaid's caramels made 75 or 100. By clues 7 and 2, Otis handed out 125: he was the robot, with licorice.
Clues 4 and 5 keep Hugo from the pirate and the scarecrow, so Hugo was the mermaid with the caramels. Dot had the gumdrops.
Hugo handed out 75 or 100. The scarecrow (clue 5) and the pirate (clue 8) both handed out fewer, so neither had 100.
So Hugo handed out 100, and Dot 75. By clue 8, the pirate handed out 75: Dot. Mabel was the scarecrow.
solution.epilogue: The Gazette printed it straight: Otis the robot, 125 licorice; Hugo the mermaid, 100 caramels; Dot the pirate, 75 gumdrops; Mabel the scarecrow, 50 taffy. Mabel checked the commas.
